<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<p><strong>Kite Hostel is the first and only kite house</strong> style hostel in Stagnone created and managed by kiters for kiters. The trained staff guarantees <strong>quality of services</strong> and attention to the needs that every wind lover needs to be able to <strong>enjoy their holiday</strong> in freedom without worrying too much about organizational aspects. If you choose to sleep with us, in our holiday home you will find all the services you are looking for and, if you want more, we will do our utmost to <strong>satisfy your needs.</strong></p>
